topology_reasoning.device_class: A compact symmetric racetrack-loop / interferometric coupler layout drawn as one connected layer-(1,0) material region.
visual_evidence: The calibrated black mask has one connected component over a 3.0 um by 5.5 um footprint.
A wide racetrack loop defines the outer boundary, with top and bottom straight sections and rounded end turns.
Two symmetric interior straight interaction rails sit above and below the center line.
Each interior rail contains a rectangular widened section with two rectangular clear slots separated by a narrow center post.
Left and right junction/taper regions connect the interior rails into the outer racetrack side regions.
topology_reasoning.working_model: The outer racetrack provides the long recirculating/phase path while the paired interior rails and slotted widened sections define coupling and local effective index. The function is therefore controlled mainly by the racetrack width/radius, the straight interaction length, the inner rail separation, slot geometry, and the taper/junction widths.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive model: extruded racetrack loop, slotted interaction blocks, rail/connectors. Diff showed high recall but extra material in the four inner side openings.
Added symmetric stepped rectangular side-opening cutouts to remove the overfilled racetrack side regions while preserving the rail and slot topology. Stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85.
